katakanaLessons.title: Vowels (アイウエオ)
katakanaLessons.description: The five basic vowel sounds in katakana — used primarily for loanwords and emphasis.

ア.tips: Looks like a stylized 'A' without the crossbar.
ア.mnemonics: A letter 'A' that lost its hat.

イ.tips: Two angled strokes meeting at the top like a roof.
イ.mnemonics: A small roof over two pillars.

ウ.tips: A roof shape with a curved bottom stroke.
ウ.mnemonics: A house with a curved roof.

エ.tips: Two horizontal lines connected by a vertical stroke.
エ.mnemonics: A ladder with two rungs and no sides.

オ.tips: A cross shape with a curved stroke through the center.
オ.mnemonics: A 'plus' sign with a curved tail.

katakanaLessons.title: K-Row (カキクケコ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'k' consonant to each vowel sound in katakana.

カ.tips: A horizontal stroke with a curved vertical coming down from its right.
カ.mnemonics: Looks like a 'K' missing its back leg.

キ.tips: Two horizontal strokes crossed by one vertical, plus a short angled stroke at bottom left.
キ.mnemonics: A cross with a floating sword.

ク.tips: A curved line with a small tick at the bottom.
ク.mnemonics: A bird's beak with a small foot.

ケ.tips: Similar to ク but with an extra angled stroke on the left.
ケ.mnemonics: A bird looking back over its shoulder.

コ.tips: Two horizontal lines — shorter on top, longer on bottom.

katakanaLessons.title: S-Row (サシスセソ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 's' consonant to each vowel sound in katakana.

サ.tips: A horizontal stroke with two vertical lines dropping from it.

シ.tips: Three short angled strokes, like dripping water.

ス.tips: A curved line with a small angled hook at the end.
ス.mnemonics: A hanger with a small hook.

セ.tips: A horizontal line with a curved stroke dropping from its right side.

ソ.tips: Two short angled strokes, one above the other.

katakanaLessons.title: T-Row (タチツテト)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 't' consonant to each vowel sound in katakana.

タ.tips: A horizontal stroke with a curved vertical dropping from its right and a short angled stroke on the left.
タ.mnemonics: Looks like カ but with an extra stroke on the left.

チ.tips: A curved stroke at the top with a longer vertical stroke beneath.
チ.mnemonics: A number '5' with a longer tail.

ツ.tips: Three short angled strokes, one above and two below.
ツ.mnemonics: A bird's footprint in the snow.

テ.tips: A horizontal stroke with a small angled stroke above and a curved vertical below.

ト.tips: A vertical stroke with a small angled tick at the bottom right.
ト.mnemonics: A walking cane with a foot.

katakanaLessons.title: N-Row (ナニヌネノ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'n' consonant to each vowel sound in katakana.

ナ.tips: A horizontal stroke with a long curved vertical dropping from its center.
ナ.mnemonics: A cross with a long tail.

ニ.mnemonics: Two horizontal shelves of equal length.

ヌ.tips: A curved stroke at the top with a sweeping diagonal through the center.

ネ.tips: A combination of strokes — horizontal top, vertical left, and sweeping diagonal from right.
ネ.mnemonics: A 'K' with an extra stroke crossing through.

ノ.tips: A single curved stroke sweeping from bottom-left to top-right.
ノ.mnemonics: A cursive 'n' written in one stroke.

katakanaLessons.title: H-Row (ハヒフヘホ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'h' consonant to each vowel sound in katakana.

ハ.tips: Two angled strokes meeting at the top like a tent.
ハ.mnemonics: A small tent or mountain peak.

ヒ.tips: A curved stroke on the left and a longer angled stroke descending from its top.
ヒ.mnemonics: A raised eyebrow with a long nose.

フ.tips: A single curved stroke that starts horizontally then angles down.
フ.mnemonics: A bent arm holding a tray.

ヘ.tips: A single angled stroke with a slight curve, like a check mark.
ヘ.mnemonics: A check mark — same as hiragana へ.

ホ.tips: A horizontal stroke with a vertical through it, plus two angled strokes on the sides.
ホ.mnemonics: A cross with two branches on the sides.

katakanaLessons.title: M-Row (マミムメモ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'm' consonant to each vowel sound in katakana.

マ.tips: Two angled strokes meeting at the top, with the left stroke extending down.
マ.mnemonics: A flying bird seen from below.

ミ.tips: Three short angled strokes stacked diagonally.

ム.tips: A long vertical stroke with a small angled stroke at the bottom left.
ム.mnemonics: A flagpole with a pennant flying left.

メ.tips: Two crossed strokes — a short horizontal and a longer diagonal.
メ.mnemonics: A large 'X' with one arm shorter.

モ.tips: Three horizontal strokes crossed by one vertical stroke.

katakanaLessons.title: Y-Row (ヤユヨ)
katakanaLessons.description: The 'y' consonant sounds in katakana — only three characters.

ヤ.tips: A curved stroke at the top with a long vertical descending from its end.
ヤ.mnemonics: A candy cane hanging from a hook.

ユ.tips: A single curved stroke forming a U-shape with a small horizontal tick at the top left.
ユ.mnemonics: A horseshoe with a small nail at the top.

ヨ.tips: Three horizontal strokes stacked evenly, the top two shorter than the bottom.
ヨ.mnemonics: Three shelves growing wider from top to bottom.

katakanaLessons.title: R-Row (ラリルレロ)
katakanaLessons.description: The 'r' consonant sounds in katakana — pronounced with a soft 'r' similar to a mix between 'r', 'l', and 'd'.

ラ.tips: A horizontal stroke with a long curved vertical dropping from its right end.
ラ.mnemonics: A number '7' with a curved tail.

リ.tips: Two short vertical strokes side by side, slightly angled.
リ.mnemonics: Two chopsticks standing side by side.

ル.tips: A curved stroke at the top with a loop at the bottom right.
ル.mnemonics: A fishhook with a small loop.

レ.tips: A single curved stroke starting horizontally then sweeping down and left.
レ.mnemonics: A check mark with a long tail.

ロ.tips: Three strokes forming a box shape — top horizontal, left vertical, and bottom horizontal.
ロ.mnemonics: A square open on the right side.

ワ.tips: A curved stroke forming a bowl shape with a short horizontal at the top left.
ワ.mnemonics: A bowl with a small lid on the left.

ヲ.tips: A combination of strokes — a horizontal top, a curved middle, and a short vertical on the right.
ヲ.mnemonics: A folded chair seen from the side.

ン.tips: Two short angled strokes — one above and one below.
ン.mnemonics: A zigzag like a lightning bolt.
